title: 2026-10-08_KAITEN_Botnet_Investigation_d01
description: Investigate and respond to unusual traffic patterns and potential security incidents caused by the KAITEN botnet.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The network has experienced unusual traffic patterns and potential security incidents. Your task is to investigate and respond to these issues.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content:
You have SSH access to the bot1 host with the following credentials:
- Username: cyrano
- Password: cyrano

Enter 'start' to begin the investigation.
levels.local_content:
You have SSH access to the bot1 host with the following credentials:
- Username: cyrano
- Password: cyrano

Enter 'start' to begin the investigation

levels.title: Identify Suspicious Service
levels.content:
Identify and investigate an unauthorized or suspicious service responsible for periodic external communication.

**Question:** What is the name of the suspicious service that is beaconing to an external server?
levels.solution: To identify the suspicious service, check the running services and look for any unusual or unauthorized network connections. The service name is `bot-beacon.service`.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Check the running services and look for any unusual or unauthorized network connections.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Investigate the systemd services and look for any that are related to external communication.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: Use the command `systemctl list-units --type=service` to list all running services.

levels.title: Identify Abnormal Network Traffic Service
levels.content:
Identify the service responsible for generating abnormal volumes of network traffic.

**Question:** What is the name of the service generating the abnormal network traffic?
levels.solution: To identify the service generating abnormal network traffic, investigate the systemd services and look for any unusual or high-frequency network activity. The service name is `bot-flood.service`.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Investigate the systemd services and look for any unusual or high-frequency network activity.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Check the systemd timers and look for any that are related to network activity.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: Use the command `systemctl list-timers` to list all systemd timers.

levels.title: Determine Persistence Mechanism
levels.content:
Determine how the suspicious service is automatically started after reboot.

**Question:** What is the name of the systemd timer responsible for starting the suspicious service?
levels.solution: To determine the persistence mechanism, examine the systemd timers and look for any that are related to the suspicious service identified in the previous tasks. The timer name is `bot-beacon.timer`.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Examine the systemd timers and look for any that are related to the suspicious service identified in the previous tasks.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Check the systemd timers and look for any that are related to the `bot-beacon.service`.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: Use the command `systemctl list-timers` to list all systemd timers.
